rationale: Choose the registered structure family: its target derives from the original bound ligand and receptor, not generated Steer or historical elite/trajectory information. The moderate-distance pair-kernel endpoint associations support testing a modest contact contribution, but are observational and do not establish causality or affinity; the structural contact remains an untyped geometrical proxy. Tighten the native geometry ratio modestly and keep the reward time-independent because the supplied feature-specific deltas do not establish a general temporal trend. These settings are hypotheses for replicated endpoint evaluation, with strain secondary and graph transitions allowed.
failure_modes: Exploratory associations may not reproduce or may reflect selection and correlated features rather than steering effects.
Original bound-ligand geometry may not represent generated conformations; contact and anchor terms do not measure physical binding energy or pIC50.
A tighter native RMS restraint can impede useful graph transitions or trade endpoint gains against strain.
The available evidence does not establish a causal optimum or support a general time-dependent effect.
